turns.text: Hello. Staff already closed my damage claim and told me the pale patches belong in the drawing. I reject that decision.
I’ve passed your complaint to a colleague, who will take over and review the previous decision. Your reference is H-1.

input.summary: Customer disputes the closure of a prior damage claim. They say staff told them the pale patches are part of the drawing, and they reject that decision. Please review the disputed decision. No order number or email provided.
